cases.title: A grant record puts its holder's context instance in reach without any membership, and the object's own policy then decides what they see
A caller with neither a membership nor a grant reaches no instance of the context at all
A grant record failing the declared condition puts nothing in reach
A grant confers no context role, so a role-gated object stays refused to its holder
A member of the very same instance passes the role-gated rule, so the refusal above is the missing role and not the missing data
A pending invitation is enough for its invitee to select the context and update the invitation, with no membership anywhere
The same invitee, reaching the same context instance, is denied a record whose rule needs a context role
A caller holding no grant cannot select the context at all, so the selection is checked and not merely believed
The same invitee is refused the same context once their invitation stops satisfying the grant condition
A member of the reached instance sees both of its invitations, so the grant-holder's single row above is read policy deciding and not an empty context
A device that has selected nothing still receives the invitation its grant reaches, and nothing else in that context
